up: Return exact IC50 activity values (in nM) for compounds tested against human prostaglandin G/H synthase 2 (CHEMBL230). For each activity, include the compound's ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, compound key, and PubMed ID or DOI. Also include the assay description and target name and organism.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  cr.compound_key,
  COALESCE(CAST(d.pubmed_id AS TEXT), d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi,
  a.standard_value AS ic50_nM,
  ass.description AS assay_description,
  td.pref_name AS target_name,
  td.organism AS target_organism
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id
LEFT JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id
WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL230'
  AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND a.standard_units = 'nM'
  AND a.standard_relation = '=';
